source_brief.target_audience: Self-directed retail traders, comfortable with charts, sensitive to fees

campaign_summary: Three concepts that inform self-directed traders about saving on ETP trades, emphasizing precision and confidence to instill trust and encourage consideration.

concepts.name: Cut the Excess
concepts.strategic_idea: Show traders the tangible impact of fee reduction by comparing trading fees to wasted resources.

visual_direction.description: Visual of a cutting tool slicing through currency symbols, representing the reduction of fees. Sharp edges, metallic textures, cool lighting.

copy_package.headline: Cut the Excess, Not Your Profits
copy_package.subheadline: Save on every ETP trade with fair pricing.
copy_package.body: Trim unnecessary costs from your trades and focus on growth.
copy_package.disclaimer: Caution. Investing involves risk of loss. Third party fees and Terms & conditions apply.
